fusions.name: Staved Forward
fusions.desc: Thrusts the haft crosswise, dealing 12 damage, leaving the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Reach Riposte
fusions.desc: A guarded thrust that deals 7 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Planted Guard
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Fallback Line
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, you gain a ward that soaks 30% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
